Subject: Yarden Manufacturing - Referral Required

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the Yarden Manufacturing submission. I've reviewed the materials you provided—everything we need is here, so thank you for the complete package.

I do need to refer this to our senior underwriting team before we can move forward with a quote. The five-year loss history shows incurred losses above $250K, which requires additional review and approval at a higher authority level.

I'll present this internally and circle back with you shortly. In the meantime, if you'd like to explore other options, you might also consider reaching out to a specialty market that focuses on higher-hazard manufacturing risks—they may be able to provide more competitive terms given the loss experience.

I'll be in touch soon.

Best regards,  
[Underwriter name]
